exposure: induction of labor for suspected intrauterine growth restriction
cohort: This study included all term singleton deliveries and their neonatal outcomes occurring in 2004 to 2008 from an unspecified population.
finding: For suspected intrauterine growth restriction at term, awaiting spontaneous labor risks fetal decompensation, yet active induction of labor might increase rates of obstetric interventions and neonatal complications of early term delivery.
birth_weight: lower than the 10th percentile adjusted for gestational age and sex
